National Museum of Egyptian Civilisation (المتحف القومى للحضارة المصرية)

A relatively small museum, with a main hall, a textile hall, and a Royal Mummies Hall. The main hall covers Egyptian culture including prehistory, the dynastic period, Greco-Roman period, Islamic period, the modern and contemporary era,…
